Weighted sampling API using ChaCha20, with add, remove, restore, and seed functions.

# Purpose
This header defines the public interface for a weighted sampling module that selects indices by stake weight using a ChaCha20-based random stream. It supports Solana-style leader schedule and Turbine tree selection, with functions to build a sampler in shared memory, seed its RNG, and sample with or without replacement. The file also defines size, alignment, and hint constants that control memory layout and sampling behavior, including support for a poisoned tail region and full restore of removed elements. Its role in the codebase is to provide a deterministic and compatible weighted selection API for components that need stake-based random choice.
